title: Risk & Compliance Specialist
description:
Why Polar?

It's never been easier to build, ship and scale software.

But it's never been harder to monetize it.

Modern startups look fundamentally different than prior generations:

  • Smaller teams
  • Exponential revenue growth relative to headcount
  • Higher variability in costs (LLMs) requiring more frequent pricing iterations
  • Laser focused on product development and distribution
  • Delegating and automating everything that is boilerplate â be it in their codebase or business operations.

Exceptional billing primitives, APIs and SDKs are essential, but delightful integration is not enough.

Startups need a billing platform designed for their speed of iteration. Combining billing and analytics in one platform to offer customer- and feature unit economics in real-time. Offering built-in pricing and cost insights, simulations and optimizations while simultaneously handling international compliance, tax management, fraud prevention and more.

That's Polar. We're building the next standard for applied AI startups.

Join our small, talented and engineering-led team across Europe as we build the infrastructure powering the next generation of software companies.

We focus on shipping at high velocity to serve startup founders scale their businesses. Everything else is secondary.

Role & responsibilities: What you will do

As a Risk & Compliance Specialist, you'll help protect the integrity of the Polar platform by reviewing merchants, identifying potential risks, and ensuring compliance with our policies and payment partner requirements. You'll partner closely with Merchant Support, Product, and Operations to balance a seamless merchant experience with effective risk management.

We're a small team, so you'll have the opportunity to do more than review accounts. You'll help improve our processes, identify emerging risk trends, and shape how Risk Operations scales as Polar grows.

You'll work with the team to:

  • Review new merchant applications and assess eligibility to sell on the Polar platform.
  • Conduct ongoing account reviews to identify changes in merchant activity or risk profile.
  • Evaluate merchants for compliance with Polar's Acceptable Use Policy and other platform requirements.
  • Investigate fraud, payment risk signals, disputes, chargebacks, and other suspicious activity.
  • Manage merchant offboarding, payout holds, and other risk-mitigation actions as needed.
  • Partner with payment providers and internal teams to resolve compliance and account-related issues.
  • Document review decisions and maintain clear, consistent internal processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve risk workflows, tooling, and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor emerging abuse trends and escalate complex or high-risk cases to leadership.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, making thoughtful decisions, and protecting the platform's integrity. You're analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with ambiguity while balancing merchant experience with compliance requirements.

You have excellent judgment, communicate clearly, and can explain difficult decisions with empathy and professionalism.

Skills & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in Risk Operations, Trust & Safety, Compliance, Fraud Operations, Payments, or Merchant Operations.
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written communication skills and the ability to explain complex decisions clearly and professionally.
  • Experience reviewing accounts, investigating fraud, or evaluating merchant risk.
  • Ability to prioritize competing priorities and make consistent, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Support, Product, and external payment partners.
  • Familiarity with SQL for investigating data, validating risk signals, and answering operational questions is a plus.

90-day Plan & Milestones

First 30 Days - Learning

â Learn Polar's products, merchant onboarding flow, and Merchant of Record model.

â Become familiar with the Acceptable Use Policy, internal review guidelines, and risk workflows.

â Shadow merchant reviews, investigations, and offboarding processes.

â Begin reviewing low-risk merchant applications with guidance.

First 60 Days - Implementing

â Independently review new merchant applications and ongoing account reviews.

â Investigate fraud signals, disputes, and payment risk cases.

â Manage standard offboarding cases and payout holds.

â Start contributing to improvements in documentation and review processes.

First 90 Days - Contributing

â Own merchant reviews from initial assessment through final decision, ensuring every case is well documented and consistently applied.

â Handle more complex risk and compliance cases.

â Identify trends and recommend operational improvements.

â Partner with Product, Support, and Operations to improve workflows and the merchant experience.

title: Partner Support Associate
description:
About Check

Payroll is broken. Come fix it alongside a team thatâs as passionate as you are!

At Check, weâre not just building our own business â weâre building payroll businesses together with every one of our partners. As the inventors of embedded payroll, weâre redefining how people get paid and making it easier for payroll businesses to launch, grow, and thrive.

On our team you'll use creative problem-solving, critical thinking, and grit to simplify the complexity of payroll for thousands of employers of every size, across all industries. We ignore conventional role boundaries in favor of the unique strengths and values each builder brings to our mission: make paying people simple.

  • Check out the full story
  • Tune in

Check is far more than just API infrastructure. Weâre a springboard for building and scaling payroll businesses.

The Support team plays a critical role in keeping payroll running for thousands of businesses and millions of workers by supporting the platforms that build payroll products on top of Check's infrastructure. When questions arise or something doesn't behave as expected, we investigate what happened, explain it clearly, and drive toward a solution.

This role sits at the intersection of payroll expertise and technical product knowledge, and the work is fast-moving, analytical, and highly investigative. A typical day involves untangling complex payroll scenarios, identifying root causes, partnering across the company to solve problems, and communicating clearly with partners whose payroll expertise may range from seasoned professionals to first-time operators. Along the way, you'll develop deep expertise in Check's platform, payroll operations, and the broader payroll ecosystem while building trusted relationships with the partner teams you support.

Support sits at the center of Check's product ecosystem. We work closely with Engineering, Product, Tax, Risk, and other teams to troubleshoot issues, surface product insights, and improve the platform. Few roles offer the same visibility into how modern payroll infrastructure operates at scale. If you enjoy solving layered problems, asking thoughtful questions, and translating technical concepts into clear, actionable guidance, you'll thrive here.

In This Role, You Will

  • Provide exceptional partner support. You'll manage a high volume of partner requests, primarily through written communication, balancing urgency with thoughtful investigation while consistently meeting or exceeding SLAs.
  • Investigate complex payroll problems. You'll dive deep into payroll and tax questions, break issues into manageable pieces, trace root causes through our systems, and drive issues toward resolution with accuracy, curiosity, and ownership.
  • Collaborate across the company to resolve issues. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Product, Tax, Risk, and other teams to troubleshoot issues, escalate bugs, and help drive solutions that unblock partners quickly.
  • Surface patterns and improve the system. You'll identify recurring partner questions, operational friction points, and product trends, surfacing insights that improve documentation, workflows, and product behavior.
  • Build trusted relationships. Whether youâre working with experienced payroll professionals or teams who are brand new to the industry, youâll build trust by bringing empathy, ownership, and transparency to every interaction and explaining technical or operational issues in ways they understand.
  • Escalate thoughtfully. Youâll exercise careful judgment about how and when to pull others in on a problem or escalate upward, and youâll ensure everyone has clear context so they can quickly understand the problem and help identify a path to resolution.
  • Deliver service that feels personal. Youâll build lasting relationships with our partners by developing a deep understanding of their platforms and the businesses they serve. Youâll establish yourself as a reliable and trusted resource by making people feel heard, helped, and valued.

Many backgrounds could fit this role, but ideal candidates will have most or all of the following:

  • 2+ years in a client- or partner-facing role, supporting customers, partners, or technical products.
  • 1+ years working at a payroll provider, payroll platform, HR technology company, fintech company, or in a role that required applying payroll knowledge to solve customer problems
  • Experience balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced support or operations environment
  • Strong investigative instincts and genuine curiosity to understand not just what happened, but why
  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy while solving complex problems
  • Comfortable collaborating across technical, operational, and administrative teams to solve partner problems and enable new business capabilities
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical or operational concepts clearly and empathetically
  • Experience using ticketing or case management systems (Zendesk preferred)
  • Willingness and availability to attend our annual 3 day company offsite each spring

Travel & Office Policy

The Check team is distributed across the US. Roles can be remote, hybrid, or based in one of our offices in New York City or San Francisco. We offer ample opportunities and encourage employees to attend team offsites, events, and hackathons throughout year. All Checketeers gather in the spring for our annual 3-day company retreat.

For our in-office and hybrid employees, our offices are open all week. We provide meals on Tuesdays and Thursdays and there are regular happy hours, game nights, and other in-person events.

Remote work at Check requires the ability to perform all responsibilities without distraction or disruption, while maintaining quality, effective communication, and productivity.

title: Expression of Interest
description:
Why we exist

We can get food, groceries and rides to our door on demand but accessing healthcare still means battling outdated systems, long waiting lists and travelling to sometimes overstretched clinical facilities.

Demand is rising, capacity in clinical settings is not coping, and patients' expectations of how they manage their health have fundamentally changed. That is why Heim exists: to build the AI layer for the last mile of healthcare, and make home the default place for patients to access care, at scale.

We surface and optimise unused practitioner availability, then work with healthcare providers to deliver care ranging from blood sample collection to wound dressing, reaching patients where and when they feel most comfortable.

About Us

We're a team of technologists, clinicians and commercial leaders with a track record of launching, scaling and exiting ventures in cloud technology and healthcare.

Before Heim, James Monico and Kelly Klifa built Testing For All, scaling the not-for-profit diagnostics provider into the go-to platform for Covid testing during the pandemic, testing over a million patients in under 18 months. Before that, James co-founded and scaled Cloudreach, exiting to Blackstone in 2017. Dr Elle Clarke, our Medical Director, is a fellow of the 2026 NHS Innovation Accelerator.

We've tripled our volume of appointments every period since going live at the end of 2023, and are backed by leading VCs in the space. We now cover 98% of the UK and hold a 4.9/5 patient rating.

Why we're asking

We're a small but mighty team and are growing quickly, which means roles open at short notice and close fast. Rather than lose good people to timing, we'd rather know who you are now. Tell us what you're interested in and we'll come back to you if and when something fits. Weâre building a picture of people across:

  • Clinical
  • Product
  • Technology
  • Growth & Commercial
  • Marketing
  • Operations & Delivery
  • HR and Finance


What We Look For, Whatever The Role

  • Extreme ownership and high velocity, paired with a real appreciation for clinical safety in a high-stakes environment
  • Low-ego collaboration across the whole organisation, engineers, commercial, clinical and implementation alike
  • Curiosity and initiative. You want to look under the hood, evaluate trade-offs and dig into the data rather than accept the first answer
  • A belief that there is beauty in simplicity, and a habit of returning to first principles on complex problems
  • A critical mind that guides the people around you towards clear decisions
  • Comfort with an unstructured, fast-moving environment, and readiness to be challenged
  • You never lose sight of the reality faced by nurses and patients out in the community


We're a small team and we get a lot of interest, so unfortunately we won't be able to come back to everyone. Your details stay on file, and if you're a fit for us, we'll be in touch!

title: Assistant Area Sales & Customer Manager
description:
Role Title: Assistant Area Sales & Customer Manager

Function: Customer Development

Location: Mumbai RO

Reporting to: Consumer Cluster Head

Here is how your day at Unilever would look like:

  • Customer Infrastructure & satisfaction: The ASCM is responsible for ensuring a robust Customer Infrastructure is in place in the territory. Distributors are appointed by the ASCM wherever necessary, and it is his/her responsibility to track their overall performance on key metrices. ASCM is supposed to optimize the quantity & quality of customers in his area such that there are no service gaps while ensuring adequate service levels for trade and financial viability for customers. She/He monitors the financial health and profitability of all Customers. The ASCM also needs to step in from time to time to resolve customer issues which cannot be handled at a field-force level. Along with his/her team (FF) the ASCM is also responsible for primary & secondary customer complaint resolution.
  • Growth & Execution: The ASCM drives Top-line growth in the area and ensures all execution metrices are also in place. She/He will also need to monitor channel-wise and category-wise growths in the territory. It is also the ASCMâs responsibility to ensure all new launches are landed in the area and to ensure all merchandising activities are run well. Execution metrics are the input metrics for delivering share gaining growth and are hence very important.
  • Drive a team: Team handling & team building are the most important aspects of an ASCMâs role. An ASCM is responsible for managing the team, motivating them and getting them to deliver their metrices. She/He needs to understand the working style and strengths and weaknesses of each person to get them to reach their potential and also needs to provide developmental inputs on a continuous basis. How an ASCM binds his/her team together is often a make-or-break factor in performance of a team.
  • Liaising with key Partner Functions: The ASCM liaises with the Supply Chain Team to ensure pack wise estimates are built correctly for the area. She/He also ensures norms build up at an RS level are hygienic and supplies from depots are in order. She/He also ensures that the stock build up at Customer points are at the acceptable level. The ASCM works with the Commercial Team to ensure customers are healthy and that payments to company are in order.
  • Ensuring controls & financial hygiene: Along with Commercial & Supply Chain team, ASCM is supposed to have check on system hygiene at customers on aspects like extent of sales return, extent of damage/ shortage claims, mismatch between primary & secondary, physical vs. book stock mismatch, trade discount
  • hygiene etc. ASCM needs to play an active role in probing cases of deviation from norms on the above-mentioned aspects.

Key Skills & Requirement

  • MBA with relevant experience.

  • Experience in a highly analytical, results-oriented environment. Preferably FMCG.

  • Deep understanding of the retail and wholesale landscape in India with prior interactions with sellers and distributors is desirable.
  • Experience in selling new products and developing markets.

title: Managing Director Discovery and Insight
description:
About Ted

TED is on a mission to discover and spread ideas that spark imagination, embrace possibility, and catalyze impact. Our organization is devoted to curiosity, reason, wonder, and the pursuit of knowledge â without an agenda. We welcome people from every discipline and culture who seek a deeper understanding of the world and connection with others, and we invite everyone to engage with ideas and activate them in your community.

About The Audacious Project

The Audacious Project is a collaborative funding platform that invites visionary changemakers to imagine their boldest ideas to solve the worldâs most urgent challenges.

Housed at TED, the nonprofit dedicated to the belief that ideas change everything, Audacious works to surface ideas that are breathtakingly ambitious yet achievable and brings together a community of philanthropists to unlock the funding needed to make them real. Each year, Audacious selects a cohort of extraordinary leaders from around the world â visionaries with proximity to the problems they're solving, and bold plans to shift systems, lift up communities, and contribute to a healthier planet.

Since its launch in 2018, Audacious has helped to catalyze more than $8B for over 70 projects across a range of issue areas. Rooted in TED's belief that ideas can come from anywhere, Audacious focuses on the strength of the idea and the team behind it, not a fixed issue area. Funded projects span science, climate, technology, health, social safety net and justice.

Job Description

Role Description

The Managing Director, Discovery and Insight leads Audacious's global search for ambitious ideas and changemakers â finding, testing, and building the case for the ideas and leaders most worth backing each funding cycle. This role owns end-to-end curation, application, and diligence activities, ultimately leading to recommendations for the cohort of finalists selected annually.

The Managing Director's work is centered on: a strategy informed by continuous learning about systems-level impact and Audacious' unique role within it; deep collaboration with applicants, donors, and partners nurtured over time; and leadership of a strong team to sustain the work.

Each year, the Discovery and Insight team conducts a global search to identify nonprofit ideas that are:

  • Innovative and offer a unique approach to a significant problem with the potential to shift the status quo or the system they operate within
  • Proximate & Community-Oriented in leadership and decision-making structure (i.e., led by those who intimately understand the problem/opportunity, incorporating impacted communities in decision-making, led by someone who has direct experience in/with the community served)
  • Approaching an inflection point or needing a significant capital inflow to catalyze a differentiated level of impact that they havenât received support for yet (rather than support for ongoing operations)
  • Thoughtfully ambitious ideas that both inspire and convince â have an exciting, breakthrough vision (âinspireâ), clear outcomes, and evidence that the idea will have a significant and concrete impact (âconvinceâ)

Key Responsibilities

  • Set and evolve the sourcing and curation strategy.
  • Advance sourcing and curation strategy for each cycle, forming a clear point of view on where Audacious should be learning, looking, collaborating, and why, ultimately carrying that strategy forward across cycles
  • Develop a âfuture-orientedâ approach by monitoring and anticipating emerging trends and innovations that Audacious actively engages with or responds to
  • Actively capture insights and lessons learned to refine and improve Audacious's sourcing and curation activities annually
  • Lead selection and diligence.
  • Apply the sourcing and curation strategy to identify the ideas most worth Audacious's attention - deciding what advances into the application stage, and bringing along multiple stakeholders and inputs along that decision-making process
  • Lead diligence on selected organizations, rigorously testing readiness, viability, and fit within Audacious's portfolio
  • Build the recommendation â evidence, rationale, and risks included â that carries an idea into finalist selection
  • Cultivate and steward the partners who bring ideas to Audacious.
  • Surface strong ideas by building genuine, ongoing relationships with social sector leaders, including funder and intermediary partners (incl. sourcing networks, collaboratives, and others)
  • Steward key partner relationships by developing a deep understanding of each stakeholderâs goals, priorities, and aspirations
  • Maintain stakeholder relationships continuously, within and across cycles, to ensure trust and rapport among all actors
  • Represent Audacious's point of view in the field, using that standing to draw the most ambitious organizations and ideas toward the platform and to create richer opportunities for sector collaboration
  • Build and nurture a team that explores the frontier of audacious social change.
  • Lead the Discovery and Insight vertical and its resourcing strategically, matching capacity to where the real work sits and bringing in the right technical expertise when needed
  • Develop people who can source, diligence, and hold partner relationships credibly in their own right â building a team of strong practitioners so Audacious's discovery capacity grows beyond any single person
  • Effectively steward relationships and actively collaborate with key Audacious partners (e.g., The Bridgespan Group) with whom we partner year-round

Qualifications

Career and Functional Experience

Essential

  • A leader who has set strategy in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments, and who can hold their own in rooms both with ultra-high net worth individuals and issue experts and with their own team, making consequential decisions grounded in clear principles and with conviction
  • Strong generalist fluency across geographic, social-change and innovation domains with the maturity and credibility to engage experts across them
  • Experience building and developing teams, leading change management efforts, and operating through influence across a senior leadership group
  • Access to, and standing within, networks across the social-change and social-innovation ecosystem

Strongly Preferred

  • Familiarity with multiple models across the sector â funder-collaborative platforms and other philanthropic sourcing and investment mechanisms
  • Experience in multinational and culturally diverse organizations

Personal Characteristics / Culture Fit

  • Strong mission orientation, high integrity leadership, alignment with Audaciousâ values
  • Creative, team-oriented, and collaborative, willing to pitch in where needed
  • Intellectually curious; a quick study who stays current on social change and emerging trends in philanthropy, and can lead on ways to evolve our work
  • Confident without certainty; decisive without rigidity
  • Judgment to lead through influence rather than ownership

What Success Looks Like

  • A strategy that evolves as the world does â growing sharper and more grounded cycle over cycle â because someone owns its development and can hold key decisions steady even when stakeholder interests pull in different directions
  • A clear, evolving sense of what belongs in Audacious's portfolio â built from what selection and diligence have taught, not assumed upfront
  • A network of donors and partners who stay engaged and where relationships are nurtured from inception, and where trust, learning, and respect are built over time
  • Recommendations reaching the Executive Director hold up because the diligence, learning, and collaboration behind them are real and rigorous

Additional Information

The deadline to submit an application for the Managing Director, Discovery & Insight role is August 19, 2026, at 11:59 pm EST.

TED Conferences LLC is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We invite all qualified candidates to apply online with their cover letter and resume.

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
Help grow an independent magazine dedicated to investigative journalism, culture and ideas.


Clandestine Magazine is looking for a Social Media Manager on a part-time voluntary basis to help grow our social media presence and introduce our work to new audiences.


We are an independent volunteer-led publication covering the stories, ideas and cultural movements shaping our world. 


We are not a conventional magazine. Our editorial landscape spans 12 topics â

Affairs â World Affairs, Cities, Environment, Philosophy, Politics and the Progressive World.

Culture â Art, Fashion, Film, Literature, Music and Technology.


Alongside our core features, we publish investigative reporting, immersive gonzo journalism, long-form essays and showcase emerging artists.


As a volunteer-led publication, we're building something with purpose. Beyond journalism, we also support charitable initiatives including a community kitchen and projects supporting people experiencing homelessness.


The Role

You'll take ownership of our social media strategy and help build a distinctive, recognisable presence that reflects the quality of our journalism and creative work.

Responsibilities include:

  • Developing and executing an Instagram & Tiktok content strategy.
  • Creating engaging posts, carousels, stories and reels.
  • Planning and maintaining a content calendar.
  • Writing compelling captions aligned with our editorial voice.
  • Growing our audience organically through community engagement.
  • Identifying trends while maintaining our editorial identity.
  • Working with editors, writers and artists to showcase new features and projects.
  • Monitoring performance and suggesting ways to improve reach and engagement.


We're Looking For Someone Who

  • Has experience managing or growing an Instagram account (personal, professional or voluntary).
  • Has a strong eye for design, storytelling and visual presentation.
  • Understands what performs well on Instagram and Tiktok without relying on clickbait.
  • Is interested in journalism, culture, current affairs or the creative industries.
  • Is proactive, reliable and enjoys taking initiative.
  • Can commit a few hours each week.


What You'll Gain

  • A key leadership role within an ambitious independent publication.
  • Creative freedom to shape our social media strategy.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with writers, editors and artists from around the world.
  • Portfolio-building experience with published work and measurable growth.


About Clandestine


Explore the world â 12 topics.


Clandestine Magazine is an independent publication dedicated to investigative journalism, the cultural zeitgeist and the ideas shaping our time.


We believe in rigorous reporting, thoughtful storytelling and publishing work that is both intellectually engaging and thought-provoking. Our pages bring together investigative features, long-form essays and distinctive voices from around the world.


We are not a conventional magazine. Our editorial landscape spans 12 topics â


Affairs â World Affairs, Cities, Environment, Philosophy, Politics and the Progressive World.


Culture â Art, Fashion, Film, Literature, Music and Technology.


Alongside our core editorial, we publish 'Injustices', examining global issues, overlooked stories and the realities that often escape the headlines. 'Gonzo' features immersive, first-hand reporting, offering deeply personal perspectives on people, places and experiences, while 'Essays' provides a home for considered long-form writing and original thought. Creativity is equally central to Clandestine, and through our 'Your Art Here' section, we offer emerging and established artists a place to showcase their work, celebrating originality and the creative voices that shape the creative disciplines of today.


Beyond publishing, we are committed to supporting charitable initiatives that help those facing hardship. Kindness, compassion and respect for others remain central to our ethos, shaping both our work and the community we continue to build. We work alongside registered charities and currently run two of our own initiatives â a community kitchen providing support for those in need, and a 'Tap for the Homeless' scheme, offering a simple way to provide essential assistance to people experiencing homelessness.


More than a magazine, Clandestine is a collective of curious minds, writers, artists and readers brought together by a shared appreciation for thoughtful journalism and culture.

description:
Overview

Digiday Media is looking for a Marketing Coordinator, Partner Programs to lead the marketing and fulfillment of sponsored programs across four premium media brands.

 

Who you are

You have about a year of experience in media and/or growth marketing and are eager to take on more responsibility. Youâre a pro and extremely reliable when it comes to managing projects and ensuring theyâre executed on time and at a high level. Youâre analytical and when it comes to solving problems, youâre able to use data to identify trends and challenges and turn those into action items. Youâre results-oriented and are extremely ambitious and motivated when it comes to delivering on those results. Most of all, youâre able to work extremely effectively across teams to be able to deliver results for our partners.

 

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the fulfillment and marketing for partner programs, including webinars, white papers, reports, surveys, guides and more. Youâll be responsible for developing promotional plans for each of these programs and executing them at an extremely high level.
  • Coordinate the distribution and promotion for each program. Youâll manage a content calendar and be responsible for using various channels across the company to promote each of these assets.
  • Report on the progress and success of each campaign. From a fulfillment standpoint, youâll keep key stakeholders informed of the progress of each campaign and make recommendations to improve performance. From a promotion standpoint, youâll track the success of the tactics being used and make recommendations in order to optimize those tactics going forward.
  • Work closely with client service and custom content teams to coordinate the logistics of campaign launches.
  • Work with the sales team on feasibility for RFPs and other programs being pitched. Youâll work closely with vp, marketing & growth to ensure all programs are sold in a way that puts Digiday Media and our partners in position to be successful.


Requirements


  • About one year of experience (internships count)
  • Media, marketing or communications background preferred. Ideally, a mix of the three.
  • A proven ability to manage a number of projects at once. Youâre extremely organized and can juggle multiple campaigns in your sleep.
  • Experience with direct response channels. Ideally, working with email marketing, display advertising, social platforms and/or other native publishing placements.
  • A willingness to âroll up your sleevesâ. Youâre happy to get your hands dirty and get s**t done.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, occasionally ambiguous environment
  • Meticulous attention to detail. Nothing gets by you.
  • Generally fluent in marketing technology


 

ABOUT DIGIDAY MEDIA

Digiday Media is a vertical media company founded in 2008 by our Chairman, Nick Friese. Our mission is to chronicle how industries like media, marketing and retail are navigating change. 


Our approach is to continually reimagine and reshape the media we create and the way we connect the industries we cover, guided by our core virtues of quality, honesty, curiosity and tenacity.


OUR BRANDS


  • Digiday: The home of modern media and marketing.
  • Glossy: Chronicling the evolution of beauty and fashion.
  • Modern Retail: Exploring the transformation of the retail industry.



OUR VALUES


  • Be respectful. We work with each other in a way thatâs empathetic, kind and productive.
  • Embrace change. Media is perpetually changing. To keep up, so are we.
  • Choose quality. Quality over quantity -- always.
  • Experiment. Weâre obsessed with finding ways to get better.
  • Be honest. Whether itâs the way we report on the industries we cover or how we work together, it starts with honesty. 


OUR BENEFITS


  • Remote work schedule flexibility. Work from where you want: home, the moon -- it's up to you.
  • Professional development:  We help pay for approved courses and training to help you grow.

title: Program Delivery Officer Level 1
description:
In this role you will ensure a high level of community safety through the delivery of approved general and /or sexual offending programs to those offenders assessed as requiring offender intervention programs.

Mandatory Requirements

The following mandatory requirements apply to this role:

  • The possession of a tertiary qualification in preferably in psychology, social work, education or behavioural sciences, however, other Bachelor degrees may be considered at the discretion of the recruitment panel in consultation with Offender Rehabilitation and Management Services.
  • Membership or affiliation with a relevant professional association will be highly regarded
  • PDO specialising in the delivery of sexual offending programs you will be provided with training in the use of relevant assessment tools (STATIC-99 and STABLE-2000) to allocate sex offenders to appropriate treatment.

The primary accountabilities of the Program Delivery Officer (Level 1) include:

  • Participate in planning activities to ensure offenders have timely access to appropriate programs and interventions
  • Prepare offenders for offender intervention programs
  • Ensure offender program activities are consistent with evidence-based practice
  • Deliver offender intervention programs in accordance with operational plans
  • Provide advice to relevant officers regarding offender program suitability and/or other interventions
  • Monitor progress of offenders during programs and related activities and report on progress
  • Comply with program management procedures, standards and guidelines
  • Identify and respond appropriately to risks arising from offender management
  • Maintain own level of knowledge of contemporary offender programs research and practices, and legislation, policy and procedures in relation to offender management
  • Participate in case management activities as required for offenders assessed as requiring program participation
  • Provide timely information to relevant sites in relation to each offender's participation in programs for case management
  • Monitor offender management files and programs to ensure continuity and consistency
  • Ensure records and information data for the Integrated Offender Management system (IOMS) are accurate and current
  • Administer appropriate assessments to offenders
  • Analyse assessment results and record information
  • Contribute to case management and sentence management activities for offenders
  • Ensure records and information data for the Integrated Offender Management system (IOMS) and the Offender Programs Assessment Service (OPAS) are accurate and current
  • Ensure maintenance, accuracy and appropriateness of records and intervention reports, program data for appropriate authorities
  • Ensure the timely provision of advice to courts, boards and other agencies regarding offenders
  • Provide program impact reports to courts and parole boards for participants
  • Promote value of offender programs to relevant agencies and support services
  • Develop productive relationships with service providers and the community generally to enhance the community's regard for offender programs

The role description provides the minimum requirements for the role. The incumbent may be required to undertake other duties as required outside of these primary accountabilities.

Applications to remain current for 12 months.

title: Compatibility
description:
CompatibilityWorking at Stripe is not for everyone

Not everyone finds success at Stripe. Those who do tend to share a few things in common.

The right people donât always think theyâre right

Successful Stripes are rigorous thinkers who appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. We want people who are not afraid to be wrong, who can enthusiastically back proposals they initially opposed, and who know how to support decisions with numbers and narrative. We operate in situations of substantial uncertainty and cannot afford either timidity or recklessness.

The global financial system can seem like a mystifying domain. It isnât. Itâs made of people and computers, like many other systems youâve worked on. Most Stripes donât come from finance, and theyâve thrived by bringing fresh perspectives. We want generalists who can parachute anywhere into our operations, learn a new field quickly, and execute competently beyond their formal remit.

We know that we canât be successful without nurturing the careers of both generalists and experts. People who thrive in high-conflict work environments often do not enjoy the experience here. We try to embrace kindness while still encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Who is Stripe for?

Ambitious builders

Weâre building solutions without clear precedent, solving problems with far-reaching consequences. The people here find that energizing, preferring the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.

Adaptable problem solvers

AI is changing how the global economy works, how our customers work, and how Stripes work. The people who thrive here adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities.

Rigorous thinkers

We argue from first principles, question assumptions, and donât stop at good enough. At Stripe, craft isnât a nice-to-haveâitâs the standard.

The most successful Stripes are the people who have the intellectual horsepower, the curiosity to learn a very complicated business, and the humility to get up every day and realize thereâs a huge amount of things they donât know.

Conor McNamaraHead of EMEA

What all Stripes have in common

Weâre dedicated to our work and optimistic about the world. We believe entrepreneurship and free markets do good, and building what supports them matters. If thatâs you, read on.

Motivated by our mission

Stripe is on a mission to grow the GDP of the internet.

Ask Yourself:

  • Do I see free markets and entrepreneurship as powerful forces for advancing progress?
  • Does enabling entrepreneurship and helping to unlock the internet economyâs full potential seem like a compelling use of my time and talents?

Embody our operating principles

âUsers firstâ is a cornerstone principle. Our users trust us to provide an essential service, and itâs a heavy responsibility that we take very seriously.

Ask Yourself:

  • Am I motivated to move mountains to protect and support businesses that depend on Stripe?
  • Am I driven to overcome obstacles and take on big things to drive progress, or do I feel overwhelmed by the sheer scale and breadth of sometimes nebulous opportunities?

Energized by change

The pace of change at Stripe and in the broader economy is accelerating. Youâll work outside your domain, take on problems that didnât exist a year ago, and be expected to adapt as quickly as the world does.

Ask Yourself:

  • Do I see a fast-moving environment as an opportunity rather than an obstacle?
  • Am I comfortable taking on problems outside my domain or experience?

Collaborative, multidisciplinary work

Building programmable financial infrastructure from first principles is inherently complex. It means that everything we create requires deep, collaborative, multidisciplinary work: technically, organizationally, and geographically.

Ask Yourself:

  • Am I excited by navigating complexity at scale?

How we operate

Youâll bring high standards to everything you do and find others who do the same.

Users first

We serve millions of businesses and a meaningful fraction of global GDP. We have a weighty responsibility to those businesses and to society. We work backwards from our usersâ needs, indexing especially on feedback from the most innovative. Everyone at Stripe talks to users.

Create with craft and beauty

With careful thought, anything can be made surprisingly great. Across every part of Stripe, we are committed to doing so. Well-crafted work indicates care for the user, and beautiful work indicates care for the world.

Move with urgency and focus

We move with speed on what matters most and take the time to invest in what will make us faster tomorrow. Whereas many companies get slower until theyâre eventually mired in mediocrity, we aspire to become the worldâs fastest company.

Collaborate egolessly

We work as one team: no fiefdoms, no hoarding information, no ânot my problem.â We question assumptions, debate energetically, and abandon ideas when better ones emerge. Weâre generous with credit and stingy with blame. We learn from mistakes together.

Stay curious

Stripe is an applied exercise in learning about how businesses tick and how the world works. Since the details and possibilities are infinite, we are always seeking to learn. Weâre energized by the unfamiliar, preferring the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.

Obsess over talent

Itâs every Stripeâs responsibility to help hire the best and to push for excellence everywhere. Managers must relentlessly uphold our high talent bar, lead their teams with clarity and context, foster development, and ultimately support Stripes in accomplishing the best work of their careers.

Our culture

Like all great workplaces, Stripe has its own working culture, with norms that can surprise, delight, and occasionally perplex.

Friday Fireside

Friday Fireside is a weekly Stripe-wide forum hosted by Patrick and John. We hear from a Stripe user and get their unvarnished feedback, invite Stripes to chat about (or demo!) their recent work, and welcome external experts to discuss timely and relevant topics.

Convergence

Every December, Stripes come together for Convergenceâa full-day event and Stripe tradition dating back to 2014. Itâs a chance to reflect on the past year, hear about our priorities for the next year, learn from each other, and poke fun at ourselves.

How we show up in the world

  • Cheeky Pint

Ideas meet the pub hang. In this podcast series, John Collison sits down with founders, builders, and leaders to discuss their craft over a pint.

Watch Cheeky Pint

  • Stripe Press

Stripe Press publishes books about ideas for economic, technological, and scientific progress. We print works we think can be broadly useful.

Find Stripe Press titles

  • Works in Progress

Stripeâs online and print magazine focuses on scientific, technological and economic advancement.

Read about Works in Progress

  • Frontier

Launched in 2022, Frontier is Stripeâs advance market commitment to buy an initial $1.8B of permanent carbon removal by 2040.

Learn about Frontier

  • Intercept

A new initiative focused on dramatically reducing the burden of respiratory viruses.

Learn about Intercept

Frequently asked questions

What is it actually like to work at Stripe day to day?

Fast-paced, intellectually demanding, and creative. The volume is high, and the problems are high stakes. But you wonât be doing it aloneâwe work with egoless collaboration. Most Stripes will tell you the caliber of their teammates is one of the things they value most, and that it raises their own standard of work.

How does Stripe invest in your growth?

Through the work itself, mostly. Stripe gives people stretch projects early, which means youâre solving problems that are hard and consequential to the business. Beyond that, we offer mentorship, direct feedback, and an annual education stipend for courses, conferences, and resources that move your career forward. The expectation is that youâll grow quickly here. Weâre set up to support you.

How does AI shape the work here?

AI is embedded in how everyone at Stripe builds, analyzes, and operates. Engineers use AI tools daily to accelerate development. Teams across product, design, and operations are building AI-powered features for the businesses and consumers who rely on Stripe. We think carefully about where AI creates real value versus where it introduces risk.

What does it mean to do your best work here?

Stripe is a place to do career-defining work. The stakes are high: millions of businesses rely on Stripe. Itâs a responsibility that requires combining urgency with high standards, an often demanding mix. In exchange, you'll have the support and opportunity to pursue big ideas and change how things work, with a high degree of autonomy.

More on careers at Stripe

  • Get our perspective on why what we build matters.

Opportunity

  • Start your career at the center of the global economyâsee what we offer for early career opportunities.

Emerging talent

  • Weâre hiring. Explore our open roles and submit your application.

Open roles

title: Menu
description:
As Abraham Lincoln once said, âThe best way to predict the future is to create it.â If you want to advance your career but donât know where to start, here are some things you can do to get promoted at work.

By Michele Reynolds

  • Be a Model Employee

Rule number one for being a good employee is to always be on time and ready to go. Even if you work in a culture that runs behind schedule, itâs better to be on timeâor even earlyâeach day and to every meeting.

If youâre leading the meeting, show up with an agenda and be an active timekeeper. Itâs a sign that youâre organized, respect peopleâs time, and serve as a role model to peers. At the end of the meeting, give a quick recap and identify next steps.

  • Solve Problems, Donât Just Identify Them

One of the best ways to stand out as a budding leaderâregardless of your current roleâis to be self-sufficient and demonstrate solid judgment. Doing so wonât just set you apart as a critical asset to your team but also serve as a tactic to further develop your leadership skills. A helpful mantra is, âBe a problem solver, not a problem identifier.â

When you raise an issue to your boss, also propose a solution. Busy leaders often get bogged down by solving every problem their team faces. Do your boss a favor and find workarounds rather than just surface issues.

  • Respect Your Bossâs Time

Be considerate of your bossâs time. Before asking for help, consider the level of urgency and try solving the problemâor at least brainstorm a plan of action to run by your manager. Making an attempt first will demonstrate you know how to take initiative.

For things that require your bossâs intervention but arenât time-sensitive, keep a running list of items to discuss. Ask if you can get some time on your managerâs calendar and outline what youâd like to discuss in your meeting invite so you both come prepared.

  • Donât Be a Squeaky Wheel

Perhaps most important is a can-do attitude. Anything you can do to minimize your bossâs workload will likely benefit you in the long run. You can help by volunteering to take on something new or brainstorm solutions when a crisis pops up.

Baseball great Wade Boggs once said, âA positive attitude causes a chain reaction of positive thoughts, events, and outcomes. Itâs a catalyst, and it sparks extraordinary results.â

So, whatever you do, donât be a whiner. Even if youâre feeling stressed, save your venting for a friend and present a positive front to your boss.

  • Serve as a Vault

Earn trust by keeping information about confidential or sensitive subjects to yourself. Beyond that, donât gossip or backstab at the water cooler. By being a stand-up employee, youâll earn trust and respect.

  • Make Your Boss Look Good

Staying organized and moving quickly can make you, and your boss, look good. But donât move too fast. Getting things done efficiently is important, but quality matters, too.

Ensure your work represents your company well. If you take on additional responsibilities, confirm they align with whatâs expected of you. Your work reflects on your boss, so make sure theyâre proud of you and your product.

  • Ask for Advice

It may seem counterintuitive, but asking your boss for advice can yield dividends. According to research (pdf) by Harvard Business School Professor Alison Wood-Brooks, âIndividuals perceive those who seek advice as more competent than those who do not.â

Timed right, asking your boss for guidance can work to your advantage.

  • Speak Up

As Aristotle said, âThereâs only one way to avoid criticism: Do nothing, say nothing, and be nothing.â Since youâre reading this article, you clearly want to stand out, so speak up.

Confidently sharing your views and expertise in conversations or meetings allows you to demonstrate your knowledge and skills. You can also make an impression on your colleagues and superiors.

  • Project Confidence

Being a strong communicator is more than what you say. How you say itâboth in your body language and tone of voiceâmay matter more than the words themselves.

Albert Mehrabian, a professor at the University of California, Los Angeles, and an expert in nonverbal communication, proved through his research that what you say is negligible compared to how you say it. Body language and inflection matter more.

âNonverbal elements are particularly important for communicating feelings and attitude, especially when theyâre incongruent: If words and body language disagree, one tends to believe the body language,â Mehrabian told the site Right Attitudes.

That said, you can look like a leader through confident body language, such as your posture, stance, handshake, eye contact, and smile.

  • Advance Your Education

What else can you do to propel your career growth? If you want to sharpen your skills but donât have the time or resources to go back to school full- or even part-time, consider taking an online course.

According to HBS Professor Das Narayandas, thereâs a plethora of options that can benefit you and your employer.

As Narayandas said to the Harvard Business Review, âThe good news is that the growing assortment of online courses, social and interactive platforms, and learning tools from both traditional institutions and upstartsâ¦offers a solution. [Theyâre] flexible and immediately accessible, and it enables employees to pick up skills in the context in which they must be used. In effect, itâs a 21st-century form of on-the-job training.â

There are many affordable online business courses that can work around your schedule. Your employer might even cover the cost.

One to consider is Leadership Principles. It features interactive exercises to help you if youâre an early- or mid-career professional preparing for a leadership role.

Chubb Fire & Security â Darwin Based FIFO Opportunity

Are you a skilled Fire Technician looking for an exciting FIFO role with incredible lifestyle balance? This is an opportunity to join Chubb Fire & Security, working one week on / one week off to support our major client on Groote Eylandt - GEMCO Sth32, while enjoying stability, training, and progression with a national market leader.

The Role

Based out of our Darwin Fire Division, you will fly from Darwin to Groote Eylandt on a 7/7 FIFO roster. You will be responsible for servicing, maintaining, and supporting fire protection assets across the site, ensuring high reliability, compliance, and exceptional customer service.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

  • Servicing, testing and maintaining fire protection assets to Chubb standards of safety, quality and delivery.
  • Completing scheduled maintenance, defect remediation and upgrade works.
  • Providing excellent customer service and technical support to our client on site.
  • Completing all documentation via the GEMCO Sth32 internal reporting system
  • Working closely with Darwin Fire Management to ensure seamless reporting, parts management and workflow planning.

Systems You Will Work On (highlighted For Editing)

ð¥ Fire Detection & Alarm Systems (e.g., Ampac)

ð¥ Sprinkler & Deluge Systems

ð¥ Gaseous Suppression Systems (e.g., Inergen / FM200)

ð¥ Fire Pump Sets

ð¥ VESDA / Aspiration Systems

To Be Successful

While experience in the Fire industry is highly regarded, it isnât essential. If you are motivated, service-driven and eager to grow your career, we will support you through full training.

You Will Need

  • Previous fire industry experience (preferred but not essential).
  • A Certificate II, Cert III or FPAS in Fire Protection (or willingness to obtain).
  • Current driverâs licence
  • White Card.
  • Ability to work FIFO on a 7/7 roster.
  • Able to pass a Police Check and Medical
  • Strong communication skills and customer-focused attitude.
  • Good time management and independence while working remotely.
  • Self-motivated, reliable and committed to safety at all times.

Benefits

Joining Chubb means joining a global fire & security leader with unmatched support and development.

  • Highly competitive wages + site allowance.
  • FIFO from Darwin with flights, accommodation and meals provided.
  • All tools, equipment and PPE supplied.
  • National and global career progression opportunities.
  • Strong training pathways and qualification assistance.
  • Supportive, high-performing team culture.
  • Excellent job stability and long-term career outlook.

Diversity & Inclusion

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experience levels.

How to Apply

gareth.masterson@chubbfs.com

Established over 200 years ago, Chubb Fire & Security are a global business driven by keeping people and the world safe. We provide essential systems, equipment and services, from digital CCTV surveillance and intruder alarms, to fire detection and suppression systems. Offering a full range of innovative products and services to a broad range of customers, from local independent business, to many of the FTSE 100 companies

We believe we offer a unique working culture, where you are as important to us as our customers, and we want you to feel that everyday. We are proud to offer extensive training to all of our new Advisors, fully supporting, and enabling you to thrive in your new role and beyond, with ongoing career development opportunities throughout your career journey with us.

title: Customer Success Architect, CEUR
Growth Marketing Architect (f/m/d)
description:
We created Apaleo to change the hospitality industry in a meaningful way. Our API-first property management platform empowers accommodation providers to design a technology stack that creates unique digital guest and staff experiences. At Apaleo, you'll find a diverse, international team united by a passion for learning and building - and we move fast.

We're looking for a Growth Marketing Architect (f/m/d) to join our team in Munich, Germany.

You won't just use AI tools - you'll design and operate the systems that turn marketing into a predictable growth engine: more intelligent, more autonomous, and measurably better at creating demand and pipeline. You'll build on what the team has already started and work shoulder-to-shoulder with channel owners - thinking in workflows, building in pipelines, and measuring everything against one thing: commercial impact, expressed as demand and pipeline.

Your mission

Build the data foundation marketing runs on

  • Audit where marketing data lives today - HubSpot, Google Analytics, LinkedIn, Contentful, etc. - and map how it actually flows (or doesn't) between systems
  • Design clean, structured data connections so every AI workflow downstream has reliable inputs - and so demand and pipeline become measurable end to end
  • Work hand-in-hand with Marketing channel owners to connect what's already there into one coherent commercial data layer that ties activity to pipeline

Build the campaign intelligence layer

  • Architect the campaign lifecycle framework that probably doesn't yet exist: which signals predict demand at each stage, how content maps to pipeline progression, what real-time campaign performance actually requires technically
  • Automate the assembly work - pulling, structuring, and summarising performance data across channels - so the team acts on insight rather than chasing it, and can see what's actually driving pipeline
  • Own and scale the campaign performance analysis pipeline from experiment to production, with demand and pipeline contribution as the headline metric

Build AI workflows that run without you

  • Design prompts, agents, and automated sequences that produce reliable outputs for repeatable marketing tasks without needing constant supervision
  • Build systems the broader marketing team can operate and iterate on independently - so the impact stays even as you move on to the next thing
  • Build toward the long-term vision: a two-way marketing intelligence loop where competitive signals automatically inform messaging, underperforming campaigns trigger content updates, and marketing shifts from reactive to continuously adaptive - compounding into a self-improving demand and pipeline engine

You'd be a great fit if you

  • Think in systems - you map a workflow before you build it, and you can clearly distinguish between steps that should be automated and steps that need a human
  • Have hands-on experience building AI-powered marketing or GTM workflows - content pipelines, enrichment flows, analytics automations, or similar
  • Connect everything to growth - you instinctively tie technical and campaign decisions to demand and pipeline, and you think in funnels, conversion, and pipeline contribution
  • Are comfortable with APIs - you can read documentation, make calls, understand endpoints and data structures, without needing an engineer beside you
  • Can write prompts that work reliably at scale
  • Understand data connectivity: you know how systems like HubSpot, GA, and marketing platforms pass data between each other, and you can design flows that don't break
  • Have a strong commercial instinct - you speak the language of B2B SaaS growth and connect every decision to a business outcome
  • Are comfortable operating in ambiguity - this is a new function and you'll be defining it as much as filling it
  • Are genuinely curious about hospitality technology and the intersection of AI and GTM
  • Write and communicate fluently in English; German is a strong plus

Culture & Growth

  • A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
  • Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
  • Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle

  • Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.
  • Free Public Transport: Travel across Germany with ease using our fully covered Deutschland Ticket.
  • Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.
  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role it's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

title: Director Brand Marketing & Community (all genders)
description:
Meet Urban Sports Club

We are among the leading platforms for sports and wellness in Europe, dedicated to inspiring people to live active, healthy lives. With just one membership we offer access to thousands of fitness and wellness experiences across the continent.

But what truly sets us apart? We believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. If you're curious about how we work, what we value and how you might grow with us, explore our Culture Hub & Career Opportunities.

*Big news: Wellhub and Urban Sports Club unite!*
Urban Sports Club is now a proud part of Wellhub, creating a global wellbeing ecosystem. Together, we connect 39,000 corporate clients and 97,000 wellness partners across 18 countries, offering millions of people even more ways to stay active and take care of their health.

 

The opportunity 

We look for a visionary Director of Brand & Community to report directly to our CEO. This is an extraordinary opportunity to shape the next chapter of an already immensely strong brand. As we enjoy incredible brand equity and awareness – particularly in our home market of Germany – you won't be starting from zero. Instead, you will inherit a premium, high-performing base to steer our consumer brand into its next major iteration: moving toward a broader, lifestyle and community-driven positioning.

A core focus of this role will be emphasizing the "Club" in Urban Sports Club. We are a community-driven concept, not just a utility app for solo check-ins. In this hybrid role, you will sit firmly on both the strategic/conceptual side and the operational frontlines. You will champion the evolution of the brand to maximize consumer appeal, while simultaneously developing and executing the concrete marketing strategies that bring our community vision to life. Your most exciting challenge? Internationalization – translating our proven local formula into scalable, culturally resonant consumer strategies for diverse international markets.

What you will do

  • Drive Brand Evolution: Architect the long-term conceptual development and narrative of Urban Sports Club, pivoting the brand toward a holistic, community-centric consumer lifestyle identity. You'll define the brand positioning, value propositions, messaging frameworks and audience strategies in collaboration with our Strategy team.
  • Strengthen the "Club": Ensure campaigns and activations reinforce the community aspect of our brand, creating emotional connections that highlight shared experiences and lifestyle rather than just functional access. We see community as driving both new member acquisition as well as member engagement.
  • Balance Strategy & Execution: Own the brand marketing strategy end-to-end, steering its execution across multi-channel campaigns, PR, Content, and Social Media.
  • Lead Internationalization: Translate, adapt, and scale the core brand strategy across international B2C markets, balancing global consistency with deep local cultural relevance.
  • Steer the Creative Studio & Teams: Oversee and mentor our multi-disciplinary brand teams and internal creative studio, fostering innovation, efficiency, and high-impact creative excellence.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary strategic brand stakeholder across the organization, collaborating closely with all marketing leaders to align brand priorities with business objectives.
  • Insights & Budget Management: Efficiently manage the global brand budget while monitoring key health metrics (awareness, sentiment, share of voice) to turn consumer insights into optimized campaign performance.

What you will need to succeed

  • 10+ years of experience leading brand management, marketing, or integrated communications, ideally within lifestyle, community or fast-paced B2C consumer industries.
  • Proven track record of developing scalable international brand strategies and managing large-scale, multi-channel campaigns.
  • Strategic & Execution Hybrid Mindset: Ability to alternate seamlessly between high-level conceptual brand building and concrete, hands-on campaign delivery.
  • Community-First Approach: A strong understanding of consumer brand positioning, audience engagement, and culturally relevant storytelling that builds community.
  • Exceptional Leadership: Strong experience leading cross-functional creative teams, PR specialists, and content creators, alongside managing external agencies.
  • Analytical & Financial Rigor: A data-driven approach to tracking brand performance metrics, translating market research into action, and managing complex global budgets.
  • Language Proficiency: Full fluency in English is required; German language skills are a significant plus.

What's in it for you 

  • Free Urban Sports Club L Pro Membership + Friends and Family Discount: Stay active with free membership, plus discounts for friends and family.
  • Flexible Work Model: Enjoy a hybrid work setup, balancing on-site and remote work options to fit your lifestyle.
  • Extended Remote Work Options: Work up to 120 days remotely within the EU, the UK, and Switzerland, including 30 days outside the EU. You'll also have the option to desk-swap at our other European offices.
  • WorkOUT Life Balance: Take advantage of 30 days of paid vacation annually, plus two additional days for volunteering, flexible working hours, and complimentary access to our mental health provider Open Up.
  • Personal Development: Receive an annual budget of €1,000 for professional growth, with regular internal training sessions and weekly German and English language classes.
  • Engaging Team Culture: Participate in regular team and company events along with wellness initiatives that help you stay productive, healthy, and engaged in a hybrid work environment.

Urban Sports Club is committed to providing a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for everyone who applies for a position or already works with us, regardless of their sports preferences, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for a Working Student (m/f/d) to join our team and help with bettering our data protection tooling and compliance. 

At FlixTech, our Data Compliance team at Foundation Division is responsible for the systems and tools that help Flix stay compliant with GDPR and other data protection regulations. Colleagues across the company use the IT tools we provide, and you'll be adjusting these tools to make being compliant with data protection regulation easier. You will work with colleagues across the company, helping them with their requests, and you will propose ways to improve our tooling to be easier to use. 

You'll be part of a cross-functional environment collaborating and have the opportunity to meet and collaborate with stakeholders from many different areas.  

About the Role

  • Respond to service tickets for two software tools (e.g. adding roles and users, updating instructions, etc.)
  • Take ownership of these two tools, making improvements on how they're setup
  • Create summary reports via the tool to identify information gaps, and to report status to key stakeholders
  • Collaborate with the team in defining next steps for what could be improved, by adding tickets to the backlog and discussing them with the team 

About You

  • Currently enrolled in any Bachelor or Master program in Berlin, preferably Law-related
  • Interest in Data Protection and privacy
  • Quick learning abilities: you enjoy figuring out how things work and dive into details autonomously
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flixbus or Flix train trips and five trips at 50% discount for your friends and family.
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access to the mental health platform OpenUp.
  • Sports perks: Discounted membership at Urban Sports Club.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Senior QA Engineer I
description:
About the role

As a Senior QA Engineer in SumUp's Hardware Tribe, you will be part of one of our small and highly skilled cross-functional teams and work together with Product Managers, Embedded Engineers, Mobile Engineers, and more. You will build sustainable solutions for testing and be accountable for the mobile testing tools that the QA team are building. Lastly, you will also be a critical decision maker in the design of hardware test infrastructures to run HIL tests and provide crucial support to software releases.

You should be an engineer with a product mindset who can fully own the features you are working on and remain flexible with changing priorities.

The role is based on-site in our office in Berlin. We believe in the power of face-to-face conversations that happen organically when working next to one another.

About the team

You have probably used our card readers to buy a cappuccino or pay your hairdresser already. In Hardware, we are passionate about creating these beautifully designed card payment devices and accessories that enable our merchants to start, run, and grow their own businesses. In doing so, we deal with a diverse range of engineering topics - industrial and electronic design, embedded systems, all the way to mobile apps and backend services.

We believe in open communication and constant learning over strict rules. If you're looking for the chance to innovate and help millions of small independent merchants succeed - join us!

What you'll do

  • Ensure that all new code of developers has the right quality and is compliant with selected best practices (in collaboration with the CL)
  • Build and maintain test infrastructure for HIL tests, with a strong emphasis on Embedded QA.
  • Ensure that multiple types of tests cover the main features (especially UI, Mobile Application, and end to end tests) 
  • Ensure that new releases are delivered timely with the right quality 
  • Evangelize a strong quality mindset within the Hardware tribe

You'll be great for this position if:

  • Expertise in Embedded QA in Linux environment
  • Experience with Object Oriented Programming (Python being a must)
  • Knowledge with REST APIs
  • Experience building test libraries
  • Expertise in testing and continuous integration strategies
  • Experience of manual testing, writing test cases and campaign management

Why you should join SumUp

  • The opportunity to work on large scale fintech products used by millions of small businesses around the world
  • A dedicated annual Learning & Development budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education
  • Enrollment onto our virtual stock ownership program - you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
  • A corporate pension scheme 
  • 28 days paid leave + 1 for birthday 
  • You'll attend global offsites and/or hackathons.
  • You'd enjoy other great benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidized office lunches and other location-tailored benefits, Babbel language platform subscription and more!

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

description:
adjoe is redefining the future of mobile ads. Powered by advanced AI, first-party data and world-class engineers, we’ve perfected the offerwall experience for monetizing and scaling app publishers with solutions like Playtime and Arcade – now the fastest growing rewarded advertising channel globally – driving incremental engagement, retention, and revenue.

At the same time, we’re breaking into programmatic advertising with the intelligent bidding system of adjoe Ads. Together, this ecosystem connects app developers to over 600 million users worldwide for scalable growth. Backed by a $100 million investment from Bertelsmann and operating from offices in Hamburg, Boston, Singapore, and Tokyo, adjoe is defining the next stages of app and ad experience – right now. Join us.

Where Talent Ambitions Meets Product Strategy

The Employee Experience team designs and operates the programs and initiatives that shape how people join, grow, and perform at adjoe. The full employee lifecycle, built to support a high-performance organization ready to build ad technologies that reach every user on the globe.

The work sits at the intersection of people strategy and execution. On one side, designing structured programs that raise the bar: performance frameworks, development initiatives, and the onboarding experience that sets the standard from day one. On the other, building adjoe's employer brand externally — telling our story on how we solve biggest adtech challenges.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in employer branding, specifically within the tech industry.

  • You will define and evolve our Employer Value Proposition, showcasing real employee journeys and career development paths across video, podcasts, social channels, and external platforms. We are looking for someone who loves connecting with people and bringing authentic human and tech stories to life.

  • You will build and manage an active engineering blog pipeline and tech content strategy. You will partner directly with developers, tech leads, and directors to translate complex backend systems and tech pillars into engaging articles, stories, and social posts.

  • You will produce your own content hands-on while also briefing and directing designers, videographers, photographers, and content writers. You are comfortable scripting video concepts, leading shoots, and working closely with creative teams to deliver polished visual assets.

  • You will audit and refine our career website, external company profiles, and job description copy to ensure our employee experience, culture, and impact-driven roles are accurately reflected for global talent.

  • You will support developers in speaking at top tech conferences by helping build compelling presentation decks, abstracts, and talk tracks.

  • You bring a balance of big-picture strategy and daily execution. You are equally excited to map out long-term talent attraction campaigns as you are to jump on camera, write copy, or collaborate directly with an engineer to draft a tech piece.

At adjoe, we're designing the organization behind one of the fastest-growing adtech platforms in mobile. The initiatives you build, the talent you develop, and the culture you shape will directly influence how adjoe scales globally.

  • Go Big. Own programs that have real impact on how 250+ people across 7 offices join, grow, and perform.
